data.name: EPT_Hakkinda_1
data.value: EgePharmTech is a collection of free, open-source computational tools for pharmaceutical technology: dissolution kinetics, f1/f2 profile comparison, pseudo-ternary phase diagrams, dose–response analysis and basic statistics.

data.name: EPT_Hakkinda_2
data.value: The tools were written by Mehmet Ali Ege, PhD, lecturer at the Department of Pharmaceutical Technology, Faculty of Pharmacy, Ege University (İzmir, Türkiye). Most of them descend from desktop programs used in the department since 1995; the pseudo-ternary phase-diagram tool dates from 2001. The "Ege" in the name is both the author's surname and Ege University (Aegean University, İzmir), where the tools originated; the site is not an official publication of the university.

data.name: EPT_Hakkinda_3
data.value: The source code is published on GitHub under the MIT licence, and the kinetics engine's results have been compared with DDSolver 1.0 outputs. If you use the tools in a publication, please cite them as described in the repository's CITATION file.

data.name: Lojistik model, doz-yanıt eğrisinin sigmoid şeklini modeller. Parametreler Marquardt-Levenberg (Levenberg-Marquardt) iteratif yöntemiyle fit edilir; LD50 ve LD90 değerleri fit edilen eğrinin ters fonksiyonundan hesaplanır.
data.value: The logistic model describes the sigmoid shape of the dose–response curve. The parameters are fitted by the iterative Marquardt–Levenberg (Levenberg–Marquardt) method; the LD50 and LD90 values are computed from the inverse function of the fitted curve.
